text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everything is rooted in my daily training. The lessons you've taught live within me and emerge naturally when I run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thus, while my soul is ablaze with the fire of determination, my heart remains as fluid as flowing water.
choice_data_list: Go show everyone what you've learned!
Go show everyone what you've learned!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes! My path is clear—here I come!
